// a menu entry: the route it leads to, the key of its label, its
// icon, and the test that says whether it is active for a given screen
class MenuEntry(val route: Any, val key: String, val icon: ImageVector, val active: (NavDestination, Any?) -> Boolean)

fun menuEntries(u: User?): List<MenuEntry> {
    if (u == null) return emptyList()
    // buildList: we fill a list, with ifs
    return buildList {
        if (u.isPatient) add(MenuEntry(Screens.MyArea, "APP.MENU_MY_AREA", Icons.Default.Home) { d, _ -> d.hasRoute<Screens.MyArea>() })
        add(MenuEntry(Screens.Schedule(), "APP.MENU_SCHEDULE", Icons.Default.DateRange) { d, _ -> d.hasRoute<Screens.Schedule>() })
        if (u.isAdmin) {
            add(MenuEntry(Screens.Persons(PersonType.DOCTORS), "APP.MENU_DOCTORS", Icons.Default.Face) { _, type -> type == PersonType.DOCTORS })
            add(MenuEntry(Screens.Persons(PersonType.CLIENTS), "APP.MENU_PATIENTS", Icons.Default.Person) { _, type -> type == PersonType.CLIENTS })
        }
        if (u.isPatient) add(MenuEntry(Screens.MyAccount, "APP.MENU_ACCOUNT", Icons.Default.AccountCircle) { d, _ -> d.hasRoute<Screens.MyAccount>() })
    }
}

@Composable
fun AppLayout(nav: NavHostController, content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependencies.current
    val u = d.session.user
    val language = LocalTranslations.current.language
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val entries = menuEntries(u)
    // the current screen, and the type of persons if it is a list or a form
    val entry by nav.currentBackStackEntryAsState()
    val destination = entry?.destination
    val type: PersonType? = when {
        destination?.hasRoute<Screens.Persons>() == true -> entry?.toRoute<Screens.Persons>()?.type
        destination?.hasRoute<Screens.Person>() == true -> entry?.toRoute<Screens.Person>()?.type
        else -> null
    }
    fun isActive(e: MenuEntry) = destination != null && e.active(destination, type)
    // a large screen: at least 800 dp wide
    val largeScreen = LocalConfiguration.current.screenWidthDp >= 800
    val drawer = rememberDrawerState(DrawerValue.Closed)
    var languageMenu by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val page = @Composable {
        Scaffold(
            topBar = {
                TopAppBar(
                    title = { Text(t("APP.TITLE")) },
                    navigationIcon = {
                        if (u != null && !largeScreen) {
                            IconButton(onClick = { scope.launch { drawer.open() } }) { Icon(Icons.Default.Menu, contentDescription = "menu") }
                        }
                    },
                    colors = TopAppBarDefaults.topAppBarColors(
                        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        titleContentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary,
                        navigationIconContentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary,
                        actionIconContentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary,
                    ),
                    actions = {
                        // FR / EN: a menu; the activity is recreated in the new language
                        TextButton(onClick = { languageMenu = true }) {
                            Text(language.uppercase(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        }
                        DropdownMenu(expanded = languageMenu, onDismissRequest = { languageMenu = false }) {
                            for (l in languages) {
                                DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text(l.uppercase()) }, onClick = {
                                    languageMenu = false
                                    changeLanguage(l)
                                })
                            }
                        }
                        if (u != null) {
                            // the session is emptied; the navigation, which observes it, displays the login screen
                            IconButton(onClick = { scope.launch { runCatching { d.session.logout() } } }) {
                                Icon(Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ExitToApp, contentDescription = t("APP.LOGOUT"))
                            }
                        }
                    },
                )
            },
        ) { innerPadding ->
            Row(Modifier.padding(innerPadding).consumeWindowInsets(innerPadding).fillMaxSize()) {
                // on a large screen: the menu, permanently
                if (u != null && largeScreen) {
                    NavigationRail {
                        for (e in entries) {
                            NavigationRailItem(
                                selected = isActive(e),
                                onClick = { nav.goTo(e.route) },
                                icon = { Icon(e.icon, contentDescription = null) },
                                label = { Text(t(e.key)) },
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    VerticalDivider()
                }
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxSize().imePadding()) {
                    SuccessMessage()
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) { content() }
                    ErrorPanel()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (u == null || largeScreen) {
        page()
    } else {
        // the drawer: only when logged in, and only on a small screen
        ModalNavigationDrawer(
            drawerState = drawer,
            drawerContent = {
                ModalDrawerSheet {
                    // the header: who is logged in
                    Column(Modifier.padding(start = 28.dp, top = 16.dp, end = 16.dp, bottom = 10.dp)) {
                        Text(u.name, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
                        SuggestionChip(onClick = {}, label = { Text(u.role.name) })
                    }
                    for (e in entries) {
                        NavigationDrawerItem(
                            label = { Text(t(e.key)) },
                            icon = { Icon(e.icon, contentDescription = null) },
                            selected = isActive(e),
                            onClick = {
                                scope.launch { drawer.close() }
                                nav.goTo(e.route)
                            },
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp),

                    }
                }
            },
        ) { page() }
    }
}

    error: String? = null,
    help: String? = null,
    params: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    secret: Boolean = false, // a password: hidden characters
    maxLength: Int? = null,
    // for the phone's password manager (username, password...)

) {

docs.title: 11.11.4. widgets/FormSubmit.kt
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// widgets/FormSubmit.kt - sending a form to the server
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// All the forms of the application follow the same pattern as
// example 25: no rule is checked on the phone (they live
// in ONE single place, the server), and in case of refusal:
//   - the error of each field (ApiError.fields) is displayed under the field;
//   - the general message (ApiError.key) is displayed at the bottom of the screen.
// This class groups these actions (it is the Command of example 23,
// completed with the errors of the fields). A screen creates one per form:
//
//     val submit = remember { FormSubmit(messages) }
//     if (submit.send { api.register(input) }) { ... }
//     InputField(..., error = submit.errors["lastName"])
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.ApiError
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.state.Messages

class FormSubmit(private val messages: Messages) {
    // the error of each field: a translation KEY
    var errors by mutableStateOf(mapOf<String, String>())
        private set

    // the parameters of the error messages ({{min}}...), sent back by the server
    var params by mutableStateOf(mapOf<String, String>())
        private set
    var inProgress by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set

    // runs the submission; returns true if it succeeded. In case of ApiError, the
    // errors are displayed and false is returned
    suspend fun send(action: suspend () -> Unit): Boolean {
        if (inProgress) return false // no double submission
        errors = emptyMap()
        params = emptyMap()
        inProgress = true
        try {
            action()
            return true
        } catch (e: ApiError) {
            messages.showApiError(e)
            errors = e.fields
            params = e.params
            return false
        } finally {
            inProgress = false
        }
    }

    // the user changes a field: its error disappears
    fun clearError(field: String) {
        if (field in errors) errors = errors - field
    }
}

The [Command] from Example 23, with field errors added: all forms in the application use it.

//     if (confirmation.confirm("SCHEDULE.CANCEL_CONFIRM")) { ... }
// "No, go back" rather than "Cancel": the question is sometimes "Cancel this
// appointment?", and a "Cancel" button would be ambiguous there.
// A new question clears the messages of the previous action.

package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog
import androidx.compose.material3.Button
import androidx.compose.material3.ButtonDefaults
import androidx.compose.material3.Text

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.state.Messages
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.i18n.t
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred

class Confirmation(private val messages: Messages) {
    var question by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
        private set
    private var pending: CompletableDeferred<Boolean>? = null

    suspend fun confirm(key: String): Boolean {
        messages.clear()
        val waiting = CompletableDeferred<Boolean>()
        pending = waiting
        question = key
        try {
            return waiting.await()
        } finally {
            question = null
        }
    }

    fun answer(yes: Boolean) {
        pending?.complete(yes)
    }
}

@Composable
fun rememberConfirmation(messages: Messages): Confirmation = remember { Confirmation(messages) }

@Composable
fun ConfirmDialog(confirmation: Confirmation) {
    val key = confirmation.question ?: return
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = { confirmation.answer(false) },
        title = { Text(t("CONFIRMATION.TITLE")) },
        text = { Text(t(key)) },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { confirmation.answer(false) }) { Text(t("CONFIRMATION.NO")) } },
        confirmButton = {
            Button(
                onClick = { confirmation.answer(true) },
                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = Color(0xFFC62828)),
            ) { Text(t("CONFIRMATION.YES")) }
        },
    )
}

// =========================================================================
// widgets/SvgImage.kt (taken from the examples, common/SvgImage.kt) - drawing an SVG image given as text
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The captcha image is built by the server, in the SVG format (a text
// that describes a drawing). Android cannot display it on its own: the
// AndroidSVG library draws it into an image (a Bitmap), that
// Compose displays with the Image component.
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.Image
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.height
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.asImageBitmap
import androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.caverock.androidsvg.SVG

@Composable
fun SvgImage(svg: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, height: Dp = 50.dp, description: String? = null) {
    // the drawing is only redone if the SVG text changes (remember(svg))
    val image = remember(svg) {
        val document = SVG.getFromString(svg)
        // drawn 3 times bigger than its "natural" size: a sharp image
        val scale = 3f
        val docWidth = (document.documentWidth.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 150f)
        val docHeight = (document.documentHeight.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 50f)
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap((docWidth * scale).toInt(), (docHeight * scale).toInt(), Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val canvas = Canvas(bitmap)
        canvas.scale(scale, scale)
        document.renderToCanvas(canvas)
        bitmap.asImageBitmap()
    }
    Image(image, contentDescription = description, contentScale = ContentScale.Fit, modifier = modifier.height(height))
}

// =========================================================================
// widgets/DropdownList.kt (taken from the examples, common/DropdownList.kt) - a ready-to-use dropdown list
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Material 3 for Compose has no all-in-one "dropdown list"
// component: it is assembled from three elements - ExposedDropdownMenuBox,
// a read-only text field, and the ExposedDropdownMenu menu. We
// do it here once and for all (examples 05 to 08, 24, 25):
//
//     DropdownList("Country", value = country, choices = listOf("fr", "be", "ch"),
//                  text = { countryNames[it] }, onChange = { country = it })
//
// The function is GENERIC (<T>): the choices can be strings,
// numbers, doctors... text says how to DISPLAY a choice. A choice
// can be null ("-- choose --") if T is a "nullable" type (Int?).
// =========================================================================
@file:OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)

package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenuItem
import androidx.compose.material3.ExperimentalMaterial3Api

import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier

@Composable
fun <T> DropdownList(
    label: String,
    value: T,
    choices: List<T>,
    onChange: (T) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    text: (T) -> String = { it.toString() },
    // an error message under the field (see examples 07 and 25)
    error: String? = null,
) {
    // is the menu open? a state SPECIFIC to each dropdown list
    var expanded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    ExposedDropdownMenuBox(expanded = expanded, onExpandedChange = { expanded = it }, modifier = modifier) {
        // the field that displays the current choice; menuAnchor makes it the
        // anchor point of the menu (touching it opens the menu)
        OutlinedTextField(
            value = text(value),
            onValueChange = {},
            readOnly = true,
            singleLine = true,
            label = { Text(label) },
            trailingIcon = { ExposedDropdownMenuDefaults.TrailingIcon(expanded = expanded) },
            isError = error != null,
            supportingText = if (error == null) null else { { Text(error) } },
            modifier = Modifier.menuAnchor(ExposedDropdownMenuAnchorType.PrimaryNotEditable).fillMaxWidth(),
        )
        // the menu: one row per choice
        ExposedDropdownMenu(expanded = expanded, onDismissRequest = { expanded = false }) {
            for (c in choices) {
                DropdownMenuItem(
                    text = { Text(text(c)) },
                    onClick = {
                        onChange(c)
                        expanded = false
                    },
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

// =========================================================================
// widgets/BookingDialog.kt - the booking dialog of a slot
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A destination of type "dialog" of the navigation (Screens.Booking):
// it is displayed ON TOP of the schedule, greyed background included, and the phone's
// Back button closes it. Its route contains everything it needs:
// the doctor, the day, the slot.
// It reads the schedule again from the CACHE (no request: the schedule has just been
// read) to find the slot in it and check that it is bookable.
// After the booking: a flash message, the closing, and the invalidation
// of the cache; the schedule, still alive under the dialog, reads itself again.
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Spacer

import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.LocalDependencies
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.ScheduleSlot
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.ApiError
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.Person
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.PersonType
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.state.isManager
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.state.isPatient
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.timeRange
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.i18n.t
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.navigation.Screens
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages.scheduleKey
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

@Composable
fun BookingDialog(route: Screens.Booking, onClose: () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependencies.current
    val u = d.session.user
    var slot by remember { mutableStateOf<ScheduleSlot?>(null) }
    // ADMIN / DOCTOR: the patients to choose from
    var clients by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<Person>()) }
    var clientId by remember { mutableStateOf<Int?>(null) }
    var sending by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        try {
            val schedule = d.cache.read(scheduleKey(route.doctorId, route.day)) { d.api.schedule(route.doctorId, route.day) }
            // only if this slot is bookable by this user
            slot = schedule.slots.find { it.id == route.slotId && it.bookable }
            if (slot == null) onClose()
            if (u.isManager) clients = d.cache.read("clients") { d.api.list(PersonType.CLIENTS) }
        } catch (e: ApiError) {
            d.messages.showApiError(e)
        }
    }

    fun confirm() {
        val c = slot ?: return
        scope.launch {
            sending = true
            try {
                d.api.book(route.day, c.id, if (u.isManager) clientId else null)
                d.messages.flash("SCHEDULE.BOOKED")
            } catch (e: ApiError) {
                if (e.key == "ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT") {
                    // no patient chosen: the dialog stays open
                    d.messages.showError(e.key)
                    sending = false
                    return@launch
                }
                // slot taken in the meantime, patient who already has an appointment...:
                // the message will be displayed on the schedule, dialog closed
                d.messages.flash(e.key, e.params, success = false)
            }
            sending = false
            onClose()
            // the server is the reference: the schedule (and the patient's area) will be read again
            d.cache.invalidate("my-area")
            d.cache.invalidate("schedule")
        }
    }

    val c = slot ?: return
    Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Column(Modifier.padding(20.dp)) {
            Text(t("BOOKING_DIALOG.TITLE"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge)
            Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
            Text(t("BOOKING_DIALOG.SLOT", mapOf("time" to timeRange(c))))
            Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
            if (u.isPatient) {
                // a patient books for themselves: no list (and the server
                // would ignore a possible clientId anyway)
                Text(
                    buildAnnotatedString {
                        append("${t("BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL")}: ")
                        withStyle(SpanStyle(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)) { append(u?.name ?: "") }
                    },
                )
            } else {
                val prompt = t("BOOKING_DIALOG.CHOOSE_PATIENT")
                DropdownList(
                    label = t("BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL"),
                    value = clientId,
                    choices = listOf<Int?>(null) + clients.map { it.id },
                    text = { i -> clients.find { it.id == i }?.label ?: prompt },
                    onChange = { clientId = it },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
            // an error (no patient chosen): the error panel of the screen is
            // hidden under the dialog, we repeat it here
            d.messages.error?.let { m ->
                Text(t(m.key, m.params), color = androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color(0xFFC62828), modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp))
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp))
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp, androidx.compose.ui.Alignment.End)) {
                TextButton(onClick = onClose) { Text(t("BOOKING_DIALOG.CANCEL")) }
                Button(onClick = { confirm() }, enabled = !sending) { Text(t("BOOKING_DIALOG.CONFIRM")) }
            }
        }
    }
}

// =========================================================================
// pages/LoginPage.kt - the login screen
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Same screen as in the other clients: login, password, captcha, and
// a second button "Create a patient account" that checks the SAME captcha
// before opening the account creation.
// login: the field is pre-filled (just after the creation of an account).
// After a successful login, this screen does NOT navigate itself: the
// session changes, and it is the navigation that leaves the login screen
// (see navigation/Navigation.kt).
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Spacer

import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

@Composable
fun LoginPage(login: String, onRegister: () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependencies.current
    val submit = remember { FormSubmit(d.messages) }
    // the input: a Map, field -> value; rememberSaveable: it survives a
    // change of language (the activity is recreated)
    var input by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(mapOf("login" to login, "password" to "", "captcha" to "")) }
    var captcha by remember { mutableStateOf<Captcha?>(null) }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    // a new image: it is needed after EACH attempt, because an image can only
    // be used ONCE (the server forgets it as soon as it has checked it)
    suspend fun reloadCaptcha() {
        captcha = try {
            d.api.captcha()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null // server unreachable: the login will fail with a clear message
        }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { reloadCaptcha() }

    fun update(field: String, value: String) {
        input = input + (field to value)
        submit.clearError(field)
    }

    // the two buttons share this sequence: sending, then, in case
    // of failure, error message and NEW image
    fun attempt(action: suspend () -> Unit) {
        scope.launch {
            d.messages.clear()
            if (!submit.send(action)) {
                input = input + ("captcha" to "")
                reloadCaptcha()
            }
        }
    }

    // on success, nothing else to do here: the navigation changes the screen
    fun logIn() = attempt {
        d.session.login(input.getValue("login").trim(), input.getValue("password"), captcha?.id ?: "", input.getValue("captcha"))
    }

    fun createAccount() = attempt {
        d.api.registrationAccess(captcha?.id ?: "", input.getValue("captcha"))
        onRegister()
    }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp)) {
        Text(t("LOGIN.TITLE"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        // autofillType: the phone's password manager can fill in the form
        InputField(
            label = "LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL",
            value = input.getValue("login"),
            onChange = { update("login", it) },
            error = submit.errors["login"],
            autofillType = ContentType.Username,
        )
        InputField(
            label = "LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL",
            secret = true,
            value = input.getValue("password"),
            onChange = { update("password", it) },
            error = submit.errors["password"],
            autofillType = ContentType.Password,
        )
        CaptchaField(
            svg = captcha?.svg,
            value = input.getValue("captcha"),
            onChange = { update("captcha", it) },
            onReload = { scope.launch { reloadCaptcha() } },
            error = submit.errors["captcha"],
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        Button(onClick = { logIn() }, enabled = !submit.inProgress, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { Text(t("LOGIN.SUBMIT")) }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        OutlinedButton(onClick = { createAccount() }, enabled = !submit.inProgress, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            Text(t("LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT"))
        }
        Text(
            t("LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP"),
            textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 4.dp),
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        DemoAccounts()
    }
}

// the demo accounts
@Composable
private fun DemoAccounts() {
    val style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall
    Text(t("LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS"), style = style, color = Color.DarkGray)
    for ((accounts, key) in listOf(
        "admin" to "LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN",
        "pelissier, tatou, dupont" to "LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR",
        "martin, durand, bistrou, german" to "LOGIN.DEMO_USER",
    )) {
        Text(
            buildAnnotatedString {
                append("• ")
                withStyle(SpanStyle(fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace)) { append(accounts) }
                append(" - ${t(key)}")
            },
            style = style,
            color = Color.DarkGray,
        )
    }
}

// =========================================================================
// pages/SchedulePage.kt - the schedule screen
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Three blocks, as in the other clients:
//   1. the choice of the doctor and of the day;
//   2. the schedule of this doctor on that day;
//   3. the booking dialog of a slot: another route,
//      Screens.Booking, displayed on top (see BookingDialog.kt).
//
// ALL the state of the screen is in its ROUTE: Screens.Schedule(doctorId, day).
// The screen DEDUCES from it what it displays, and the user's actions
// change the route (onView, onBook); the phone's Back button
// closes the booking dialog.
//
// What each one sees and can do is decided by the SERVER (fields
// patient, mine, bookable, appointmentId of each slot): the screen merely
// displays it. A patient does not even receive the name of the other patients.
// =========================================================================
@file:OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)

// the key of the schedule of a doctor on a given day, in the cache
fun scheduleKey(doctorId: Int?, day: String) = "schedule/$doctorId/$day"

@Composable
fun SchedulePage(
    doctorId: Int?,
    day: String?, // as is in the route: maybe invalid
    onView: (Int?, String) -> Unit,
    onBook: (Int?, String, Int) -> Unit,
    onMyArea: () -> Unit,
) {
    val d = LocalDependencies.current
    val user = d.session.user
    val confirmation = rememberConfirmation(d.messages)
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    // the day: the route's one if it is valid, otherwise today
    val invalidDay = day != null && !isValidDate(day)
    val theDay = if (day != null && !invalidDay) day else today()

    var doctors by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<Person>()) }
    // the schedule (null as long as it has not arrived, or if there is none)
    var schedule by remember { mutableStateOf<Schedule?>(null) }
    var loading by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    // the doctors: read once (cache); an error is displayed at the bottom of the screen
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        try {
            doctors = d.cache.read("doctors") { d.api.list(PersonType.DOCTORS) }
        } catch (e: ApiError) {
            d.messages.showApiError(e)
        }
        if (invalidDay) d.messages.showError("ERRORS.INVALID_DATE")
    }

    // the schedule: read again if the route changes (another doctor, another day) or if the
    // cache is invalidated (booking, cancellation: d.cache.version changes).
    // Without a doctor in the route, a DOCTOR sees THEIR schedule (the server
    // finds it from the token); the others see nothing
    val hasSchedule = !invalidDay && (doctorId != null || user?.role == Role.DOCTOR)
    LaunchedEffect(doctorId, theDay, d.cache.version) {
        if (!hasSchedule) {
            schedule = null
            return@LaunchedEffect
        }
        loading = true
        try {
            schedule = d.cache.read(scheduleKey(doctorId, theDay)) { d.api.schedule(doctorId, theDay) }
        } catch (e: ApiError) {
            schedule = null
            d.messages.showApiError(e)
        }
        loading = false
    }

    // the server is the reference: after a cancellation, the schedule is read again
    // (and the patient's area, which shows their appointment)
    fun cancel(c: ScheduleSlot) {
        val appointmentId = c.appointmentId ?: return
        scope.launch {
            if (!confirmation.confirm("SCHEDULE.CANCEL_CONFIRM")) return@launch
            try {
                d.api.cancelAppointment(appointmentId)
                d.messages.showSuccess("SCHEDULE.CANCELLED")
            } catch (e: ApiError) {
                d.messages.showApiError(e)
            }
            d.cache.invalidate("my-area")
            d.cache.invalidate("schedule")
        }
    }

    val a = schedule
    // the displayed doctor: the route's one, or the one of the received schedule (DOCTOR)
    val shownId = doctorId ?: a?.doctor?.id
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(12.dp)) {
        // 1. the choice of the doctor and of the day. key: if the route changes, the
        // form is recreated, and starts again from the new values
        androidx.compose.runtime.key(shownId, theDay) {
            DoctorDayPicker(doctors = doctors, doctorId = shownId, day = theDay, onView = onView)
        }
        // patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no "Book" button
        a?.info?.let { info ->
            Card(colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = Color(0xFFE1F5FE)), modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp)) {
                ListItem(
                    colors = androidx.compose.material3.ListItemDefaults.colors(containerColor = Color.Transparent),
                    headlineContent = { Text(t(info)) },
                    trailingContent = { TextButton(onClick = onMyArea) { Text(t("APP.MENU_MY_AREA")) } },
                )
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        when {
            loading && a == null -> Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(24.dp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { CircularProgressIndicator() }
            a != null -> ScheduleView(
                schedule = a,
                // "Book" changes the ROUTE: the booking dialog opens
                onBook = { c -> onBook(shownId, theDay, c.id) },
                onCancel = ::cancel,
            )
            else -> Text(t("SCHEDULE.EMPTY_STATE"), Modifier.padding(16.dp))
        }
    }
    ConfirmDialog(confirmation)
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. the choice of the doctor and of the day: a small form, whose state is
// only useful before sending. It STARTS with the values of the route.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
@Composable
private fun DoctorDayPicker(doctors: List<Person>, doctorId: Int?, day: String, onView: (Int?, String) -> Unit) {
    var id by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(doctorId) }
    var theDay by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(day) }
    var calendar by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val language = LocalTranslations.current.language
    // the chosen doctor must be in the list (otherwise: none)
    val knownId = id.takeIf { i -> doctors.any { it.id == i } }
    // t() is a @Composable function: we translate BEFORE the text lambda, which is not one
    val prompt = t("DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DOCTOR")
    Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Column(Modifier.padding(12.dp)) {
            DropdownList(
                label = t("DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DOCTOR_LABEL"),
                value = knownId,
                choices = listOf<Int?>(null) + doctors.map { it.id },
                text = { i -> doctors.find { it.id == i }?.label ?: prompt },
                onChange = { id = it },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
            // the day: a read-only field; touching it opens the calendar
            Box {
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = longDate(theDay, language),
                    onValueChange = {},
                    readOnly = true,
                    label = { Text(t("DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DAY_LABEL")) },
                    trailingIcon = { Icon(Icons.Default.DateRange, contentDescription = t("DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DAY")) },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                // a transparent surface, on top of the field, that receives the touch
                Box(Modifier.matchParentSize().clickable { calendar = true })
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
            Button(onClick = { onView(knownId, theDay) }, enabled = knownId != null, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Text(t("DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.VIEW_SCHEDULE"))
            }
        }
    }
    if (calendar) {
        val state = rememberDatePickerState(initialSelectedDateMillis = toMillis(theDay))
        DatePickerDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { calendar = false },
            // Android's OK / Cancel texts, in the application's language
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = {
                    state.selectedDateMillis?.let { theDay = fromMillis(it) }
                    calendar = false
                }) { Text(stringResource(android.R.string.ok)) }
            },
            dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { calendar = false }) { Text(stringResource(android.R.string.cancel)) } },
        ) { DatePicker(state = state) }
    }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. the schedule
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
@Composable
private fun ScheduleView(schedule: Schedule, onBook: (ScheduleSlot) -> Unit, onCancel: (ScheduleSlot) -> Unit) {
    val language = LocalTranslations.current.language
    Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Column(Modifier.padding(vertical = 8.dp)) {
            ListItem(
                headlineContent = { Text("${t("SCHEDULE.TITLE_PREFIX")} ${longDate(schedule.day, language)}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium) },
                supportingContent = { Text(schedule.doctor.label) },
            )
            if (schedule.slots.isEmpty()) Text(t("SCHEDULE.NO_SLOTS"), Modifier.padding(16.dp))
            for (c in schedule.slots) {
                HorizontalDivider()
                Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        // the bookable slots are slightly colored
                        .background(if (c.bookable) Color(0xFFE8F5E9) else Color.Transparent)
                        .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
                ) {
                    Text(timeRange(c), fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium, modifier = Modifier.width(96.dp))
                    Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        when {
                            c.free -> Tag(t("SCHEDULE.FREE"), Color(0xFF2E7D32))
                            c.patient != null -> Tag(c.patient.label, if (c.mine) Color(0xFF3F51B5) else Color(0xFF757575))
                            else -> Tag(t("SCHEDULE.BOOKED_BY_OTHER"), Color(0xFF757575))
                        }
                    }
                    when {
                        c.bookable -> OutlinedButton(onClick = { onBook(c) }) { Text(t("SCHEDULE.BOOK")) }
                        c.appointmentId != null -> OutlinedButton(
                            onClick = { onCancel(c) },
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.outlinedButtonColors(contentColor = Color(0xFFC62828)),
                        ) { Text(t("SCHEDULE.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT")) }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun PatientAreaPage(onMyAccount: () -> Unit, onSchedule: (Int?, String?) -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependencies.current
    val language = LocalTranslations.current.language
    val confirmation = rememberConfirmation(d.messages)
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var area by remember { mutableStateOf<MyArea?>(null) }

    LaunchedEffect(d.cache.version) {
        try {
            area = d.cache.read("my-area") { d.api.myArea() }
        } catch (e: ApiError) {
            d.messages.showApiError(e)
        }
    }

    fun cancel(appointmentId: Int) {
        scope.launch {
            if (!confirmation.confirm("SCHEDULE.CANCEL_CONFIRM")) return@launch
            try {
                d.api.cancelAppointment(appointmentId)
                d.messages.showSuccess("SCHEDULE.CANCELLED")
            } catch (e: ApiError) {
                d.messages.showApiError(e)
            }
            // the area AND the schedules have changed
            d.cache.invalidate("my-area")
            d.cache.invalidate("schedule")
        }
    }

    val e = area
    if (e == null) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { CircularProgressIndicator() }
        return
    }
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(12.dp)) {
        Text(t("AREA.HELLO", mapOf("name" to e.patient.label)), style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall, modifier = Modifier.padding(4.dp))
        Option(Icons.Default.AccountCircle, t("AREA.MANAGE_ACCOUNT"), t("AREA.MANAGE_ACCOUNT_HELP"), onMyAccount)
        Option(Icons.Default.DateRange, t("AREA.VIEW_SCHEDULE"), t("AREA.VIEW_SCHEDULE_HELP")) { onSchedule(null, null) }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(12.dp)) {
                Text(t("AREA.MY_APPOINTMENT"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
                // normally only one (rule "one upcoming appointment at a time"),
                // but the screen can display several
                for (appt in e.appointments) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    Text("${longDate(appt.day, language)}, ${timeRange(appt.slot)}", fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                    Text(appt.doctor.label)
                    FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        // the doctor's schedule on that day: the patient sees their name in it
                        TextButton(onClick = { onSchedule(appt.doctor.id, appt.day) }) { Text(t("AREA.SEE_IN_SCHEDULE")) }
                        OutlinedButton(
                            onClick = { cancel(appt.id) },
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.outlinedButtonColors(contentColor = Color(0xFFC62828)),
                        ) { Text(t("AREA.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT")) }
                    }
                }
                if (e.appointments.isEmpty()) Text(t("AREA.NO_APPOINTMENT"), color = Color.Gray, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp))
            }
        }
    }
    ConfirmDialog(confirmation)
}

// =========================================================================
// pages/PersonsConfig.kt - doctors or clients?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The management screens of the doctors and of the clients are IDENTICAL: same
// list, same form. We write them ONCE (PersonsPage.kt,
// PersonFormPage.kt); only the address of the API and the
// keys of the labels change, described here. The route passes the type to each screen.
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages

import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.Person
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.PersonType

data class PersonKeys(
    val title: String, // "Doctors"
    val add: String, // "Add a doctor"
    val edit: String, // "Edit a doctor"
    val empty: String, // "No doctors."
    val confirmDelete: String,
    val added: String, // "Doctor {{name}} has been added (login: {{login}})."
    val updated: String,
    val deleted: String,
    val notFound: String, // the record has been deleted in the meantime
)

// the keys of a type: written only once, thanks to the "DOCTORS." or "CLIENTS." prefix
fun keys(type: PersonType): PersonKeys {
    val p = if (type == PersonType.DOCTORS) "DOCTORS" else "CLIENTS"
    return PersonKeys(
        title = "$p.TITLE",
        add = "$p.ADD",
        edit = "$p.EDIT",
        empty = "$p.EMPTY",
        confirmDelete = "$p.DELETE_CONFIRM",
        added = "$p.ADDED",
        updated = "$p.UPDATED",
        deleted = "$p.DELETED",
        notFound = if (type == PersonType.DOCTORS) "ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND" else "ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND",
    )
}

// {{name}} and {{login}} of the "added / updated / deleted" messages
fun messageParams(p: Person) = mapOf("name" to "${p.firstName} ${p.lastName}", "login" to (p.login ?: ""))

@Composable
fun PersonsPage(type: PersonType, onAdd: () -> Unit, onEdit: (Int) -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependencies.current
    val c = keys(type)
    val confirmation = rememberConfirmation(d.messages)
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    // null: not loaded yet
    var list by remember(type) { mutableStateOf<List<Person>?>(null) }
    var failed by remember(type) { mutableStateOf(false) }

    // read again if the type changes or if the cache is invalidated
    LaunchedEffect(type, d.cache.version) {
        try {
            list = d.cache.read(type.path) { d.api.list(type) }
        } catch (e: ApiError) {
            failed = true
            d.messages.showApiError(e)
        }
    }

    fun delete(p: Person) {
        scope.launch {
            if (!confirmation.confirm(c.confirmDelete)) return@launch
            try {
                d.api.delete(type, p.id)
                d.messages.showSuccess(c.deleted, messageParams(p))
            } catch (e: ApiError) {
                // a doctor who still has appointments: 409 ERRORS.DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS
                d.messages.showApiError(e)
            }
            d.cache.invalidate(type.path)
        }
    }

    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val l = list
        if (l == null) {
            // not loaded yet (or loading failed: the message is at the bottom of the screen)
            if (!failed) CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.align(Alignment.Center))
        } else {
            // some room at the bottom, so as not to hide the last row under the floating button
            LazyColumn(contentPadding = PaddingValues(start = 8.dp, top = 8.dp, end = 8.dp, bottom = 88.dp)) {
                item { Text(t(c.title), style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall, modifier = Modifier.padding(8.dp)) }
                if (l.isEmpty()) item { ListItem(headlineContent = { Text(t(c.empty)) }) }
                // one row per person; key: the identity of the row
                items(l, key = { it.id }) { p ->
                    Card(Modifier.padding(vertical = 4.dp)) {
                        ListItem(
                            leadingContent = {
                                Box(Modifier.size(40.dp).background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer, CircleShape), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                                    Text("${p.firstName.first()}${p.lastName.first()}")
                                }
                            },
                            headlineContent = { Text(p.label) },
                            supportingContent = { Text(p.login ?: "", fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace) },
                            trailingContent = {
                                Row {
                                    IconButton(onClick = { onEdit(p.id) }) { Icon(Icons.Default.Edit, contentDescription = t("PERSONS.EDIT")) }
                                    IconButton(onClick = { delete(p) }) {
                                        Icon(Icons.Outlined.Delete, contentDescription = t("PERSONS.DELETE"), tint = Color(0xFFC62828))
                                    }
                                }
                            },
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        ExtendedFloatingActionButton(
            onClick = onAdd,
            icon = { Icon(Icons.Default.Add, contentDescription = null) },
            text = { Text(t(c.add)) },
            modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomEnd).padding(16.dp),
        )
    }
    ConfirmDialog(confirmation)
}

// =========================================================================
// pages/PersonFormPage.kt - creation OR update of a doctor
// or of a client (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//     Screens.Person(DOCTORS)          -> creation (no id)
//     Screens.Person(DOCTORS, id = 3)  -> update
// Two components:
//   - PersonFormPage reads the record to update (if there is one);
//   - Form is only displayed once the record has been read: it STARTS with
//     its values (initial state), without having to copy them later.
// No rule is checked here: the server validates everything, and its errors
// are displayed under the fields (see widgets/FormSubmit.kt).
// The VERSION read with the record goes back with the update: if another
// ADMIN has updated it in the meantime, the server answers 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE.
// =========================================================================

private val empty = mapOf("title" to "Mr", "firstName" to "", "lastName" to "", "login" to "", "password" to "")

@Composable
fun PersonFormPage(type: PersonType, id: Int?, onList: () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependencies.current
    // the starting values: empty (creation), or those of the record read
    var initial by remember { mutableStateOf<FormData?>(if (id == null) empty else null) }

    if (id != null) {
        LaunchedEffect(id) {
            try {
                // WITHOUT cache: the record must be up to date (otherwise the form
                // would start with an outdated version: 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE)
                val p = d.api.read(type, id)
                initial = mapOf("title" to p.title, "firstName" to p.firstName, "lastName" to p.lastName, "login" to (p.login ?: ""), "password" to "", "version" to p.version)
            } catch (e: ApiError) {
                // record that does not exist (deleted in the meantime...): back to the list
                d.messages.flash(e.key, e.params, success = false)
                onList()
            }
        }
    }
    val start = initial
    if (start == null) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { CircularProgressIndicator() }
    } else {
        Form(type, id, start, onList)
    }
}

// the form itself
@Composable
private fun Form(type: PersonType, id: Int?, initial: FormData, onList: () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependencies.current
    val c = keys(type)
    val creating = id == null
    val submit = remember { FormSubmit(d.messages) }
    // an editable COPY of the starting values
    var input by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(initial) }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    fun update(field: String, value: String) {
        input = input + (field to value)
        submit.clearError(field)
    }

    fun save() {
        scope.launch {
            val succeeded = submit.send {
                val p = if (id == null) d.api.add(type, input) else d.api.update(type, id, input)
                d.messages.flash(if (creating) c.added else c.updated, messageParams(p))
            }
            val key = d.messages.error?.key
            if (succeeded) {
                d.cache.invalidate(type.path) // the list has changed
                onList()
            } else if (key == c.notFound) {
                // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: back to the list
                d.messages.flash(key, success = false)
                onList()
            }
        }
    }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp)) {
        Text(t(if (creating) c.add else c.edit), style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        PersonFields(values = input, errors = submit.errors, onChange = ::update)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        Text(t("PERSONS.ACCOUNT_SECTION"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall)
        InputField(
            label = "PERSONS.LOGIN_LABEL",
            maxLength = 30,
            value = input["login"] as String,
            onChange = { update("login", it) },
            error = submit.errors["login"],
            help = if (creating) "PERSONS.LOGIN_HELP_CREATE" else "PERSONS.LOGIN_HELP_EDIT",
        )
        // never pre-filled: the password never comes back from the server
        InputField(
            label = "PERSONS.PASSWORD_LABEL",
            secret = true,
            maxLength = 72,
            value = input["password"] as String,
            onChange = { update("password", it) },
            error = submit.errors["password"],
            params = submit.params,
            help = if (creating) "PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_CREATE" else "PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT",
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Button(onClick = { save() }, enabled = !submit.inProgress) { Text(t("PERSONS.SAVE")) }
            OutlinedButton(onClick = onList) { Text(t("PERSONS.BACK")) }
        }
    }
}

// minimum length of a password chosen by a patient: same value
// as the server (which also sends {min} with the PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT error)
const val PASSWORD_MIN = "6"

@Composable
fun RegisterPage(onLogin: (String) -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependencies.current
    val submit = remember { FormSubmit(d.messages) }
    var input by rememberSaveable {
        mutableStateOf(mapOf("title" to "Mr", "firstName" to "", "lastName" to "", "login" to "", "password" to "", "confirmation" to ""))
    }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    // the guard SPECIFIC to this screen: without a pass, back to the login
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        val valid = runCatching { d.api.registrationAccessStatus() }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (!valid) {
            d.messages.flash("ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT", success = false)
            onLogin("")
        }
    }

    fun update(field: String, value: String) {
        input = input + (field to value)
        submit.clearError(field)
    }

    fun create() {
        scope.launch {
            var login = ""
            val succeeded = submit.send { login = d.api.register(input) }
            if (succeeded) {
                // back to the login screen, login pre-filled
                d.messages.flash("REGISTRATION.DONE", mapOf("login" to login))
                onLogin(login)
            } else if (d.messages.error?.key == "ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT") {
                // expired pass (15 minutes): back to the captcha
                d.messages.flash("ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT", success = false)
                onLogin("")
            }
        }
    }

    // the parameters of the help message AND of the password errors
    val passwordParams = mapOf("min" to PASSWORD_MIN) + submit.params
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp)) {
        Text(t("REGISTRATION.TITLE"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
        Text(t("REGISTRATION.INTRO"), color = Color.Gray)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        PersonFields(values = input, errors = submit.errors, onChange = ::update)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        Text(t("PERSONS.ACCOUNT_SECTION"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall)
        InputField(
            label = "PERSONS.LOGIN_LABEL",
            maxLength = 30,
            value = input.getValue("login"),
            onChange = { update("login", it) },
            error = submit.errors["login"],
            help = "REGISTRATION.LOGIN_HELP",
            autofillType = ContentType.NewUsername,
        )
        InputField(
            label = "PERSONS.PASSWORD_LABEL",
            secret = true,
            maxLength = 72,
            value = input.getValue("password"),
            onChange = { update("password", it) },
            error = submit.errors["password"],
            params = passwordParams,
            help = "REGISTRATION.PASSWORD_HELP",
            autofillType = ContentType.NewPassword,
        )
        InputField(
            label = "ACCOUNT.CONFIRMATION_LABEL",
            secret = true,
            maxLength = 72,
            value = input.getValue("confirmation"),
            onChange = { update("confirmation", it) },
            error = submit.errors["confirmation"],
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {

            OutlinedButton(onClick = { onLogin("") }) { Text(t("REGISTRATION.BACK_TO_LOGIN")) }

}

@Composable
fun MyAccountPage(onMyArea: () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependencies.current
    // read again at each visit, without cache: its version must be up to date
    var account by remember { mutableStateOf<MyAccount?>(null) }

            account = d.api.myAccount()

            d.messages.showApiError(e)

        } else {

        }
